summary: The page covers the assigned rollout decisions, labels its examples and matches cited claims to the supplied source records. No FAQ is assigned or included. Live link availability was not independently checked.

decisions: Whether a person is accepted to use the system in a role or needs more practice.

Whether to accept, extend or repeat the pilot, including approval of exceptions.
How to classify and resolve pilot task failures and whether a system problem blocks rollout.
Whether to approve or hold the start of a deployment stage.
Whether to pause, roll back or continue with a workaround when a serious problem occurs.
Whether to accept rollout as complete or request further action.
Whether retraining, reconfiguration or vendor help is needed for low adoption or increased workload.
